name: NeXGold Mining Corp.
summary: NeXGold Mining Corp. is a Canadian company focused on exploring and advancing gold projects. Its central asset is the wholly owned, high-grade Goliath Gold Complex near Dryden, Ontario, which combines the Goliath, Goldlund and Miller projects. The Goliath property covers about 7,601 hectares. Founded in 1997, the company was previously Treasury Metals Inc.
